overview_description.description: Garaak is a carpooling service that connects car owners with potential co-commuters within their community. Garaak is to solve the transportation crisis, traffic, and car air pollution in Egypt.  A car owner can make an account on Garaak, by adding the details, car photos, and driver’s license to be verified that it is active. After accepting him or her as a driver, he or she can add trips, choose the number of available chairs, and identify the price of the chair. Then the passenger searches and sends a request to the driver to go on the same trip. Thus, the driver or the car owner can increase his income without any effort.
